headline: AI-scare + oil spike create deep semi/gold oversold and energy overbought — all setups face Wed FOMC binary risk before acting.
AI-scare oversold semis vs. oil-spike overbought energy — FOMC Sep 16 is the binary that could flip both.
Energy/defense overbought on Iran shock premium; bonds, gold, and XLY oversold on rate-hike fear — all eyes on today's CPI before any entry.
Oil-war shock and rate-hike binary have stretched yield-sensitive sectors to extreme oversold and energy/defense to overbought — PPI today and CPI tomorrow are the reversion trigger to watch.

US/Iran escalation is creating the most compressed oversold extremes in bonds, industrials & rate-sensitives — while oil ETFs sit at multi-year overbought highs; the reversion trade is the rate-fear unwind, not the energy trade.
